Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 marker: 1 once Guard Thorne or Guard Corrin beats the player and holds them for the Captain (Village_Master_Plan.md §10.8.11.3). Captain Sterling's Duty_SterlingFinishArrest reads this and his own Encounter clears it back to 0 once it resolves. Distinct from cmcStatArrestPending, which self-clears the same tick it fires and cannot hold a durable state across a multi-hour walk.
